record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together through the real entry point, document the feature, and run the full suite.

## Approach

Add a tmux popup test to `tests/test_e2e_dashboard.py` (name containing `evidence`, marked `tmux`). It seeds a structured phase through the CLI, opens the dashboard popup through `se-workflow.tmux`, and steps it: unassessed, an assessment routing to design (seen under Needs you), then verified assessments and a ready release (seen as R n/m verified, the stage word, and Release ready). Then open a requirement detail by keys.

README: in the dashboard section, document the requirement detail and how to reach it, the R n/m tally, the stage strip and stage word, the Release ready badge, and the loop-route and integration Needs-you items.

Run every acceptance below, then the full suite.
record.subject: verify-evidence-view
